explanation:
The new chat rail renders an
  • @handle
    • row for everyone the viewer follows, so on the following page a followed user has a row in both the rail and the list. FollowListPage's unscoped listitem locator resolves to two elements. The collision appears only once the rail's follow list has been fetched.
fix: Scope every FollowListPage locator to the page's own <main>; the rail <aside> is a sibling.
